title: MQ runtime identity
description: Which code a runtime is. Identity is component + version + commit: two builds can carry the same semver, so a version alone does not identify a runtime. A component reports its own identity; nothing infers it from the working directory, the process path, or the latest tag. An identity that cannot be completed is recorded as partial or unknown rather than guessed.

component.description: The MQ component reporting itself, e.g. mq-agent or mq-mcp.

version.description: The package version the runtime reports. Null when it cannot be read; never taken from a tag or a sibling checkout.

commit.description: The commit the running code was built from. Null when the build carries no commit metadata — a weaker identity, not a missing one to be filled in from the latest tag.

install_type.description: How this runtime was installed. `unknown` when it cannot be proven; never inferred from a path that merely looks like a checkout.

identity_quality.description: How complete the identity is. `verified` needs component, version and commit; `partial` has a version but no commit; `unknown` could not identify the runtime at all. Constrained below, so a record cannot claim more than it carries.

started_at.description: When a long-lived runtime began. Null for a CLI invocation, which has no process to outlive the command.

executable.description: The entry point that was run, when known.

module_path.description: The package directory actually imported. This, not the working directory, is where a runtime lives.

source_path.description: The checkout the imported code lives in, for an editable install. Null when the runtime is installed from a built artifact.
